caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular plaque or sign with a muted beige background and a slightly irregular border that suggests it is set against a roughly painted backdrop. At the top of the plaque, there are two large, oval shapes in a dark blue or indigo color, outlined in a lighter shade and joined at their narrow ends, forming a shape similar to a sideways figure eight or an infinity symbol. Surrounding these ovals are six stylized leaf shapes, three on each side, rendered in a similar blue color with touches of green. Below the decorative design, there is text arranged in five lines, written in uppercase serif letters. The text, centered on the plaque and rendered in a greyish-blue color, reads: “COMMERAW’S / STONEWARE / CORLEARS / HOOK / N. YORK.” The overall composition is simple and balanced, with the blue decorative motif occupying the upper part and the text filling the lower half. In the lower right corner, there is a small signature reading “ROLAND De LASK.”
title: Jug
